_comment: GAFA AML Rule Engine — Configurable Thresholds. Change values here, restart the server for changes to take effect.

INCOME_MISMATCH._comment_rsf: RSF = (|TotalCredits - TotalDebits| for month) / Stated Monthly Income. Flag HIGH if RSF > this value.
INCOME_MISMATCH._comment_rsf_med: Flag MEDIUM if RSF is between RSF_MEDIUM_THRESHOLD and RSF_HIGH_THRESHOLD.

TRANSACTION_VELOCITY._comment_spike: Flag if current-month count > SPIKE_MULTIPLIER x historical average count.
TRANSACTION_VELOCITY._comment_baseline: Number of prior months used to compute the historical average count.
TRANSACTION_VELOCITY._comment_min: Minimum transaction count in current month before velocity rule activates (avoids false positives on new accounts).

TIME_ANOMALY._comment: Transactions between ODD_HOUR_START_IST and ODD_HOUR_END_IST (Indian Standard Time, 24h) are considered anomalous.
